title: AP Demo Stats
description: Stats band under the split Get a Demo booking hero (live #ap-demo-stats on /test-calendar-demo-weekly/): three big gradient numbers that count up on first view, each over a label. On desktop it is 128px tall (108px on short screens) so it and the hero fill one screen. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
